#### Reference Issues/PRs

#### What does this implement/fix? Explain your changes.

#### Any other comments?

Sign off every commit (`git commit -s`), run the suite (`cd environment_lab && pip install -e ".[hosted-api,dev]" && python -m pytest tests`), no em dashes in prose, and no change to the runner, aggregator, PDPs, oracle, catalog, scoring or evidence semantics without a versioned proposal.
